views.name: bowler_scores_won_and_handicap
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MatchID,
  GameNumber,
  BowlerID,
  RawScore,
  HandiCapScore,
  WonGame
FROM
  Bowler_Scores
WHERE
  WonGame = 1
views.description: All individual bowler game score rows from the current Bowler_Scores table filtered to winning games and exposing raw and handicap scores and keys for joins. This is a reusable cohort of winning games with score measures.

views.name: bowler_identity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Bowlers.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  Bowlers.BowlerFirstName AS BowlerFirstName,
  Bowlers.BowlerLastName AS BowlerLastName,
  Bowlers.TeamID AS TeamID,
  Bowlers.BowlerCurrentAverage AS BowlerCurrentAverage,
  Bowlers.BowlerCurrentHcp AS BowlerCurrentHcp
FROM Bowlers
views.description: Canonical bowler identity and current season aggregate stats from Bowlers table. Exposes name fields and BowlerID for joining to scores and for selecting bowler-level attributes.

views.name: match_game_tournament_context
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mg.MatchID,
  mg.GameNumber,
  tm.TourneyID,
  t.TourneyDate,
  t.TourneyLocation,
  tm.OddLaneTeamID,
  tm.EvenLaneTeamID,
  mg.WinningTeamID
FROM Match_Games AS mg
JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm
  ON mg.MatchID = tm.MatchID
JOIN Tournaments AS t
  ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
views.description: Denormalized relation that links match games to their tournament metadata via Match_Games -> Tourney_Matches -> Tournaments. One row per match game (match + game number) with tournament date and location and participating team ids.
